Quick technical notes ahead of tomorrow's session:

1) Load-test plan (from the YAML):
- smoke: 5 rps for 5 minutes (validate auth + basic routing)
- ramp: increase to 25 rps over 5 minutes, hold 10 minutes
- peak: 50 rps for 10 minutes, then cool down

2) Metrics we'll capture: 99th/95th latency, p50, error rate by model variant, token costs, and KV-cache hit ratio. We'll push these into a shared Grafana dashboard (link in invite).

3) Privacy: if you plan to include real PII in prompts, please flag or provide masked examples. For the ramp we recommend synthetic payloads mirroring token length distribution to protect data and avoid retention concerns.

4) Network/whitelist: send us the public egress IPs for the session if you want explicit allowlist; otherwise we can use short-lived secure tunnels.

I'll attach an updated loadtest snippet with headers and retry logic.

Jordan / team —

Thanks for running the session today. Quick recap and open items so we have shared ownership:

Recap:
- Prompt review: we iterated on three prompts (order-summary, policy-check, customer-response) and landed on small edits to reduce hallucination risk.
- Routing: demoed model routing by intent; Redwood's fallback to a cheaper quantized variant behaved as expected under throttling.
- Load test: ramped to 50 rps for 10 minutes; average p50 latency was ~210ms, p95 420ms, p99 spikes at ~780ms for large-context prompts. Error rate stayed under 0.7%.

Action items (owners / target dates):
- Provide finalized 3 prompt set (Stratatek) — owner: Alex Rivera — due 2026-11-05
- Add allowlist IPs or confirm tunnel approach (Stratatek/Sam) — owner: Kim Lee / Sam Holmes — due 2026-11-03
- Redwood to share detailed load-test dashboard and raw metrics export — owner: Dev Patel — due 2026-11-04
- Marissa to export the prompt-engineering worksheet with recommended rewrites — owner: Marissa Cole — due 2026-11-04
- Propose next hands-on follow-up focused on model selection & quantization tradeoffs (two-hour session) — target window 2026-11-09 to 2026-11-12; Redwood to propose two slots.

Please reply with confirmations or adjustments. We'll also log these in the HubSpot deal (STX-2026-148).

Thanks again — good momentum.
Alex
